templates.content:
# Copyediting Checklist

<!-- Chapter number -->

## Language & Style
- [ ] Consistent voice and tone
- [ ] Reading level appropriate
- [ ] Jargon defined on first use
- [ ] Gendered language avoided
- [ ] Active voice preferred

## Formatting
- [ ] Heading hierarchy correct
- [ ] Figure/table numbering sequential
- [ ] Cross-references accurate
- [ ] Footnotes/endnotes consistent
- [ ] Bibliography format correct

## Technical Accuracy
- [ ] Equations numbered and formatted
- [ ] Units consistent (SI / Imperial)
- [ ] Significant figures appropriate
- [ ] Code samples tested (if applicable)

## Permissions
- [ ] All borrowed material attributed
- [ ] Permission letters on file
